stem.en: A metal alloy well established as biocompatible for a long-term hip implant is proposed, without further evaluation, for a completely different application: a resorbable scaffold meant to degrade and be replaced by natural bone tissue over a few months. What is the flaw in this proposal?
stem.et: Metallisulam, mis on hästi tuvastatud biosobivana pikaajalise puusaimplantaadi jaoks, pakutakse ilma edasise hindamiseta täiesti erinevaks rakenduseks: resorbeeritavaks tugiraamistikuks, mis on mõeldud lagunema ja asendatama loodusliku luukoega mõne kuu jooksul. Mis on selles ettepanekus viga?

label.en: Biocompatibility and appropriate degradation rate are specific to the application; a material chosen to remain permanently inert is the wrong design target for an application that instead needs controlled degradation over months.
label.et: Biosobivus ja sobiv lagunemiskiirus on rakendusspetsiifilised; materjal, mis on valitud jääma püsivalt inertseks, on vale disainisiht rakenduse jaoks, mis vajab selle asemel kontrollitud lagunemist mõne kuu jooksul.

label.en: Since the alloy is already proven biocompatible, it should work equally well for any implant application without further evaluation.
label.et: Kuna sulam on juba tõestatud biosobivana, peaks see töötama võrdselt hästi igasuguse implantaadi rakenduse jaoks ilma edasise hindamiseta.

label.en: Since it already performed well in a hip implant, it must also be the right choice for a heart valve or dental implant, since it is generally 'a good biomaterial.'
label.et: Kuna see toimis hästi puusaimplantaadis, peab see olema õige valik ka südameklapi või hambaimplantaadi jaoks, kuna see on üldiselt 'hea biomaterjal.'

label.en: A biomaterial's mechanical performance inside the body should remain static over time just like a non-biological engineering material, so degradation is not something to plan around.
label.et: Biomaterjali mehaaniline jõudlus kehas peaks jääma ajas staatiliseks nagu mitte-bioloogiline inseneriteaduslik materjal, seega ei ole lagunemine miski, mille ümber peaks planeerima.
